title: The etale residue colimit maps surjectively to K
statement: The etale residue colimit maps surjectively to K.

proof.text: Apply the polynomial lifting theorem to each element of K, then apply the supplied simple-root lifting hypothesis to obtain a preimage in the colimit.

proof_origin: Reduced by worker F2 to the polynomial lifting intermediate theorem.
